name: Inspect Ed25519 public key
description: Resolve a secret-backed Ed25519 seed and return only its public AccountKey and DID.

seed.description: Secret reference to a 32-byte hexadecimal Ed25519 private seed: s/NAME or <did>/s/NAME. Never pass a raw seed.

accountKey.description: Native 32-byte Ed25519 AccountKey; JSON renders it as a 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string.

did.description: Ed25519 did:key for this public key.
